subject: history
title: Civil War, NEP and the Death of Lenin
welcome_lead: From War Communism to NEP and the question of Lenin's heir.
meta_desc: A-Level adventure on the Russian Civil War 1918-21, War Communism, NEP and Lenin's death in January 1924.
final_note: You can evaluate how Lenin entrenched the one-party state.

concepts.def: Peace signed 3 March 1918 ceding Poland, the Baltics, Ukraine and Finland to the Central Powers.
1918-21 emergency policy: grain requisitioning, nationalisation, labour conscription, ration cards.
Secret police founded December 1917 under Felix Dzerzhinsky, instrument of the Red Terror.
Sailors' uprising at Kronstadt naval base (28 February-18 March 1921) demanding 'Soviets without Bolsheviks'.

walkthroughs.body_html: Brest-Litovsk took Russia out of the war but cost vast territory. Whites under Kolchak, Denikin, Yudenich and Wrangel were uncoordinated; Allied intervention by Britain, France, the US and Japan failed to tip the balance. Trotsky's Red Army (5 million by 1920) exploited interior lines. The royal family was murdered at Ekaterinburg (16-17 July 1918). The Red Terror followed Lenin's attempted assassination (30 August 1918). The Polish-Soviet War (1920) ended at the Treaty of Riga (March 1921).

Industrial output by 1921 was about one-fifth of 1913. The Kronstadt Mutiny and the Tambov peasant rising forced retreat. The Tenth Party Congress (March 1921) introduced NEP and the ban on factions, marking a tightening of internal discipline even as the economy liberalised. The famine of 1921-22 killed perhaps 5 million; American Relief Administration aid was accepted.

The USSR was constituted on 30 December 1922. Lenin suffered strokes from May 1922; his Testament warned against Stalin and Trotsky. He died on 21 January 1924; Petrograd was renamed Leningrad. Stalin manoeuvred with Zinoviev and Kamenev against Trotsky, who lost the leadership of the Left Opposition by 1925.

mcqs.q: Why did Lenin introduce the NEP in 1921?
options: War Communism had collapsed the economy and provoked the Kronstadt revolt; the NEP allowed limited private trade to restore production and stabilise Bolshevik rule.
It was caused by Henry VIII's break with Rome.
The NEP was introduced by Stalin to fund the Five-Year Plans.
The NEP was Lenin's plan to permanently switch Russia to capitalism.
Stalin took power by leading the Red Army to victory in the Civil War.
It was caused by Henry VIII's break with Rome.
Stalin took power because Lenin nominated him as his successor.
No — Lenin's Testament (1922-23) warned against Stalin's rudeness and recommended his removal; Stalin won by manoeuvring against Trotsky after Lenin's death.

mcqs.q: What caused the English Civil War?
options: Stalin took power by leading the Red Army to victory in the Civil War.
It was caused by Charles I trying to arrest five MPs in 1642.
It was caused by Henry VIII's break with Rome.
Long-term tensions over royal absolutism, religion (Laudian reforms), and parliamentary rights, combined with Charles I's specific mismanagement and personal rigidity.
